title: Structura Reditus Research Library — Identifier Reservation (SR-RESERVATION.v0.1.0)
description: Additive, public-safe ledger entry recording that one identifier value in one namespace has been reserved for one operation. Reservations are infrastructure records, not registry surfaces: they carry no research content and transfer no authority. A reserved value is never reused for different work and never recycled after withdrawal or failure. Stored one file per reservation under registry/reservations/<value>.json; excluded from load_registry().

operation_key.description: Public-safe operation reference (UUID or opaque key). Never an email, account id, or private draft reference.

purpose.description: Short public statement of what the value is reserved for (e.g. 'new research object family', 'author registration').

state.description: reserved = held for the operation; published = the committed record exists; withdrawn = the operation ended without a record. Withdrawn values are never reallocated.

published_record_path.description: Repository-relative path of the committed record once state is published.
